nights.title: Three Dog Night
nights.name: Three Dog Night
nights.extract: Three Dog Night is an American rock band formed in Los Angeles in 1967, founded by vocalists Chuck Negron, Cory Wells, and Danny Hutton. This lineup was soon augmented by Jimmy Greenspoon (keyboards), Joe Schermie, Michael Allsup (guitar), and Floyd Sneed (drums). The band had 21 Billboard Hot 100 top 40 hits between 1969 and 1975, with three hitting number one. Three Dog Night recorded many songs written by outside songwriters, and they helped to introduce mainstream audiences to writers such as Harry Nilsson ("One"), Randy Newman, Paul Williams, Laura Nyro and Hoyt Axton.

en.who: Three Dog Night is an American rock band formed in Los Angeles in 1967, founded by vocalists Chuck Negron, Cory Wells, and Danny Hutton. This lineup was soon augmented by Jimmy Greenspoon (keyboards), Joe Schermie, Michael Allsup (guitar), and Floyd Sneed (drums).
facts: The band had 21 Billboard Hot 100 top 40 hits between 1969 and 1975, with three hitting number one.
They helped to introduce mainstream audiences to writers such as Harry Nilsson, Randy Newman, Paul Williams, Laura Nyro and Hoyt Axton.

de.who: Three Dog Night ist eine amerikanische Rockband, die 1967 in Los Angeles gegründet wurde. Gründer waren die Sänger Chuck Negron, Cory Wells und Danny Hutton. Die Besetzung wurde bald durch Jimmy Greenspoon (Keyboards), Joe Schermie, Michael Allsup (Gitarre) und Floyd Sneed (Schlagzeug) erweitert.
facts: Zwischen 1969 und 1975 hatte die Band 21 Top-40-Hits in den Billboard Hot 100, drei davon erreichten Platz eins.
Sie machten ein breites Publikum mit Songwritern wie Harry Nilsson, Randy Newman, Paul Williams, Laura Nyro und Hoyt Axton bekannt.

tr.who: Three Dog Night, 1967 yılında Los Angeles'ta kurulmuş bir Amerikalı rock grubudur. Grubun kurucu vokalistleri Chuck Negron, Cory Wells ve Danny Hutton'dı. Kadro kısa süre içinde Jimmy Greenspoon (klavye), Joe Schermie, Michael Allsup (gitar) ve Floyd Sneed (davul) ile genişledi.
facts: Grup 1969 ile 1975 arasında Billboard Hot 100 listesinde 21 ilk 40 hiti aldı; bunların üçü birinci oldu.
Three Dog Night, Harry Nilsson, Randy Newman, Paul Williams, Laura Nyro ve Hoyt Axton gibi söz yazarlarını geniş kitlelere tanıttı.

nights.title: Doja Cat - Tour Ma Vie World Tour
nights.name: Doja Cat
nights.extract: Amala Ratna Zandile Dlamini, known professionally as Doja Cat, is an American rapper and singer-songwriter. Regarded as the "Queen of Pop-Rap", she is known for her musical versatility, live performance skills and humorous internet presence. Billboard named her "one of the world's biggest pop stars" and "one of the defining pop stars of this era", and Time listed her as one of the world's most influential people in 2023.

en.who: Amala Ratna Zandile Dlamini, known professionally as Doja Cat, is an American rapper and singer-songwriter. Regarded as the "Queen of Pop-Rap", she is known for her musical versatility, live performance skills and humorous internet presence.
facts: Billboard named her "one of the world's biggest pop stars".
Time listed her as one of the world's most influential people in 2023.

de.who: Amala Ratna Zandile Dlamini, unter dem Namen Doja Cat bekannt, ist eine amerikanische Rapperin und Singer-Songwriterin. Als „Queen of Pop-Rap“ gilt sie als vielseitige Musikerin mit starken Live-Auftritten und einer humorvollen Präsenz im Internet.
facts: Billboard bezeichnete sie als einen der größten Popstars der Welt.
Time zählte sie 2023 zu den einflussreichsten Menschen der Welt.

tr.who: Amala Ratna Zandile Dlamini, sahne adıyla Doja Cat, bir Amerikalı rapçi ve şarkıcı-söz yazarıdır. "Pop-Rap'in Kraliçesi" olarak anılır; müzikal çok yönlülüğü, canlı performans becerileri ve eğlenceli internet varlığıyla bilinir.
facts: Billboard onu "dünyanın en büyük pop yıldızlarından biri" olarak nitelendirdi.
Time dergisi onu 2023 yılında dünyanın en etkili insanlarından biri olarak listeledi.

nights.title: Jodeci
nights.name: Jodeci
nights.extract: Jodeci is an American R&B quartet consisting of members K-Ci, JoJo, DeVanté Swing, and Mr. Dalvin. Formed in 1988 in Charlotte, North Carolina, Jodeci began as a duo of DeVanté Swing and JoJo but later both added their brothers. After signing with Uptown Records in 1990, the group finished work on their debut album, Forever My Lady (1991), which brought them mainstream success with three straight Billboard R&B No. 1 hit singles: the album's titular track, "Stay" and "Come and Talk to Me".

en.who: Jodeci is an American R&B quartet consisting of members K-Ci, JoJo, DeVanté Swing, and Mr. Dalvin. Formed in 1988 in Charlotte, North Carolina, Jodeci began as a duo of DeVanté Swing and JoJo.
facts: After signing with Uptown Records in 1990, the group finished work on their debut album, Forever My Lady (1991).
Their debut album brought them mainstream success with three straight Billboard R&B No. 1 hit singles.

de.who: Jodeci ist ein amerikanisches R&B-Quartett aus K-Ci, JoJo, DeVanté Swing und Mr. Dalvin. Gegründet wurde die Band 1988 in Charlotte, North Carolina, als Duo aus DeVanté Swing und JoJo.
facts: Nach der Unterzeichnung bei Uptown Records im Jahr 1990 vollendete die Gruppe ihr Debütalbum Forever My Lady (1991).
Das Debütalbum brachte ihnen mit drei aufeinanderfolgenden Billboard-R&B-Nummer-eins-Singles den Mainstream-Erfolg.

tr.who: Jodeci, K-Ci, JoJo, DeVanté Swing ve Mr. Dalvin'den oluşan bir Amerikalı R&B dörtlüsüdür. 1988 yılında Charlotte, North Carolina'da DeVanté Swing ve JoJo'nun ikilisi olarak başladı; daha sonra ikisi de kardeşlerini gruba kattı.
facts: 1990 yılında Uptown Records ile anlaştıktan sonra grup, ilk albümü Forever My Lady'nin (1991) çalışmalarını tamamladı.
Bu albüm, üç ardışık Billboard R&B birinci sıra single'ı ile grubu ana akım başarıya taşıdı.

nights.title: Metallica: Life Burns Faster
nights.name: Metallica
nights.extract: Metallica is an American heavy metal band. It was formed in Los Angeles in 1981 by vocalist/guitarist James Hetfield and drummer Lars Ulrich, and has been based in San Francisco for most of its career. The band's fast tempos, instrumentals and aggressive musicianship made them one of the founding "big four" bands of thrash metal, alongside Megadeth, Anthrax and Slayer. Metallica's current lineup comprises founding members and primary songwriters Hetfield and Ulrich, longtime lead guitarist Kirk Hammett and bassist Robert Trujillo. nights.title: THE LETTERMEN
nights.name: The Lettermen
nights.extract: The Lettermen are an American male pop vocal trio whose trademark is close-harmony pop songs with light arrangements. The group started in 1959. They have had two Top 10 singles, 16 Top 10 singles on the Adult Contemporary chart, 32 consecutive Billboard chart albums, 11 gold records, and four Grammy nominations.

The group has had 32 consecutive Billboard chart albums, 11 gold records, and four Grammy nominations.

nights.title: UB40
nights.name: UB40
nights.extract: UB40 are an English reggae band, formed in December 1978 in Birmingham, England. The band has had more than 50 singles in the UK singles chart and has also achieved considerable international success. They have been nominated for the Grammy Award for Best Reggae Album four times and were nominated for the Brit Award for Best British Group in 1984. UB40 have sold more than 100 million records worldwide. The ethnic make-up of the band's original line-up was diverse, with musicians of English, Welsh, Irish, Jamaican, Scottish and Yemeni parentage.

en.who: UB40 are an English reggae band, formed in December 1978 in Birmingham, England. The band has had more than 50 singles in the UK singles chart and has also achieved considerable international success.
facts: They have been nominated for the Grammy Award for Best Reggae Album four times.

de.who: UB40 sind eine englische Reggaeband, die im Dezember 1978 in Birmingham, England, gegründet wurde. Die Band hatte mehr als 50 Singles in den britischen Singlecharts und feierte auch internationale Erfolge.
facts: Viermal wurde die Band für den Grammy in der Kategorie Best Reggae Album nominiert.
UB40 haben weltweit mehr als 100 Millionen Tonträger verkauft.

tr.who: UB40, Aralık 1978'de Birmingham, İngiltere'de kurulmuş bir İngiliz reggae grubudur. Grup, Birleşik Krallık single listesinde 50'den fazla single'a sahip oldu ve uluslararası alanda da önemli başarılar elde etti.
facts: Grup, Grammy'nin En İyi Reggae Albümü dalında dört kez aday gösterildi.
UB40 dünya genelinde 100 milyondan fazla plak sattı.

nights.title: Bryan Adams - Bare Bones Acoustic Solo Show
nights.name: Bryan Adams
nights.extract: Bryan Guy Adams is a Canadian singer-songwriter, musician, record producer, and photographer. He is estimated to have sold between 75 million and more than 100 million records and singles worldwide, placing him among the best-selling music artists. Adams was the most played artist on Canadian radio in the 2010s and has had 25 top 15 singles in Canada and over a dozen in the U.S., UK, and Australia.

en.who: Bryan Guy Adams is a Canadian singer-songwriter, musician, record producer, and photographer. Adams was the most played artist on Canadian radio in the 2010s.
facts: He is estimated to have sold between 75 million and more than 100 million records and singles worldwide.

de.who: Bryan Guy Adams ist ein kanadischer Singer-Songwriter, Musiker, Musikproduzent und Fotograf. In den 2010er-Jahren war er der meistgespielte Künstler im kanadischen Radio.

In Kanada hatte er 25 Top-15-Singles, in den USA, Großbritannien und Australien über ein Dutzend.

tr.who: Bryan Guy Adams, bir Kanadalı şarkıcı-söz yazarı, müzisyen, müzik yapımcısı ve fotoğrafçıdır. 2010'larda Kanada radyolarında en çok çalınan sanatçı oldu.
facts: Dünya genelinde 75 milyon ile 100 milyonun üzerinde plak ve single sattığı tahmin ediliyor.
